Subject: Post-call: Egress validator, SDK auth & rerank integration

Hi Samira / Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

High-level summary
- Goal: Put Novaly into a small production path for the search reranker feature while keeping model traffic off the public internet (VPC endpoint + egress controls).
- Scope: SDK setup, auth model, routing to a dedicated Redwood endpoint (VPC), structured output/tool-calling enabled for reranker hooks, and embeddings pipeline integration.

Technical items we agreed to confirm from Novaly:
1) IP allowlist or peering preference (we can support VPC endpoint or IP allowlist; picking one will determine firewall & DNS work).
2) TLS approach: customer-managed mTLS certs vs Redwood-managed client cert; if you prefer mTLS we need sample certs and rotation window.
3) Egress flow: will requests originate from your backend or from client devices? We recommend backend-only for sensitive data.
4) Embeddings / rerank flow: you'll call embeddings (text-embed-2-large) -> store vectors in VectorNest -> call Redwood /rerank endpoint with candidate IDs + embedding context.

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Novaly infra (Alex): send IP ranges or confirm peering preference by EOD Wed (attachments: network scan we ran for reference).
- Grace: schedule a 30-min tech handoff for Wed or Thu to walk through SDK auth snippets.
- Jordan: draft an "egress validator" checklist (DNS record we will create, sample mTLS handshake, test token).

Attachments: novaly_network_scan.pdf (scan of sample egress test), integration-checklist.xlsx (our suggested items).

If all looks good we'll follow up with a concrete list of firewall rules and a short pre-prod smoke test plan.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I've sketched a technical validator and included a couple of suggested concrete values to speed Novaly's firewall/route prep. Attaching egress_ranges_approx.txt with the samples.

Validator checklist (minimal)
- DNS: Create CNAME redwood-api.novaly.internal -> vpce-<redwood-id>.private.redwood.net (we'll provide the vpce when ready).
- IP ranges (placeholder; we'll confirm exact ranges for your region): 34.213.0.0/16, 52.42.128.0/18, 18.205.0.0/16.
- TLS/Auth: Start with Redwood-managed client certs (we'll issue a client cert for Novaly service account). If you opt for mTLS later: supply a PEM cert + key and rotation window (we recommend 90 days).
- Token model: Use short-lived OIDC tokens (recommended) bound to service account; SDK supports refresh flow.
- Structured output/tool-calling: enable parameter structured_output=true in SDK. We'll provide a sample schema for the reranker hooks (action: rerank, fields: score, reason, meta).
- Embeddings flow: text-embed-2-large -> VectorNest index (upsert) -> /rerank call with candidate_ids + embed_context. For latency-sensitive rerank, do synchronous embed of query and batched candidate scoring on Redwood.

Smoke test script (deliverable)
1) TLS handshake to vpce endpoint (curl --resolve or internal DNS)
2) POST /v1/embeddings (sample payload) -> verify 200 and vector dims
3) POST /v1/rerank (sample payload referencing candidate IDs) -> verify structured_output is present and score fields included

I'll prepare a small tar with the script and the checklist; Ben will hand it to Alex during the call.

--
Jordan Blake
Principal Infrastructure Eng (Redwood)
